newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee rebounds to end with slight gains.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee rebounds to end with slight gains.

text.p: Nearby robusta coffee futures rebounded from early lows to end Friday with slight gains on scale-down roaster buying, traders said.
By the finish, benchmark January firmed $5 at $1,460 a tonne after ranging $1,435 and $1,469. The market slipped early under the weight of trade-related hedge selling.

Traders noted no or little speculative interest, the main factor behind Thursday's rally which pushed January to $1,476 -- the highest level since mid-October. Volume was a modest 4,670 lots, again centred on the January position.
Nearby Nov/Jan spread stood at $85, almost the same as Thursday's close.
In options, business was fairly brisk with 1,277 lots done. These included 250 lots January $1,450/$1,500 call spread which traded at $20.
